summary: Wait until only the six Operator pods remain, then `oc scale --replicas=0 deployment aap-gateway-operator-controller-manager automation-controller-operator-controller-manager` and bring up the database with `oc scale --replicas=1 statefulset.apps/aap-postgres-15`.
questions: Which operators do I scale down before restoring AAP on OpenShift?
How do I start Postgres while AAP is idled?

answer_card.title: Scale down operators, start Postgres
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc scale --replicas=0 deployment aap-gateway-operator-controller-manager automation-controller-operator-controller-manager
oc scale --replicas=1 statefulset.apps/aap-postgres-15
```
